title: Plans, usage metering and billing through Prospectus
description:
Why: only people who will pay get a site: no free plan, no trial. Price is by usage (only cost matters), metered and billed through Prospectus, the Anthus CRM and central account service (repository Prospectus; docs/BILLING.md for the billing model, docs/QUOTA.md for the weekly usage quota). No per-seat and no per-agent pricing. Custom domains are in every plan. Consumes the Prospectus work already listed in PPY-a1e75a.
Done when: in staging, sign-up to paid live site has no human step.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Workstream (e), metering and cost control, tasks: PPY-6d9a6d (what Prospectus must add), PPY-3fd951 (metering event catalogue), PPY-889ab5 (spend gate with hard ceiling), PPY-49d059 (daily shared-resource report), PPY-994bd0 (per-tenant lease and fair queue), PPY-f40a02 (adaptive noisy-neighbour limits), PPY-d7c279 (acceptable use and takedown).

Prospectus as read 2026-11-08 (develop 8b8e6b8): quota check/usage/reservation routes are built (docs/QUOTA.md); cost accounting in microdollars with per-deployment attribution and a usage-based split of shared resources is agreed, not built (docs/COST_ACCOUNTING.md); billing lines are per product per Account with interval plans, 'pricing out of scope', Stripe not built, and no automatic suspension (docs/BILLING.md); products are one reviewed entry per site in accounts/papyrus-sites.json, which blocks self-serve sign-up until a shared 'papyrus' product with deployments exists.

comments.author: home
comments.text: New tasks (Ryan 2026-11-08): PPY-966ef5 one papyrus product with data deployments, PPY-6cb44b lifecycle events and revised decision 7, PPY-8a3c6a overage billing, PPY-25e0d7 cost accounting on our sites and the design partner's sites.
